name: eevee-light-shader-output-direct-volume
purpose: Verify the Eevee Light Shader Output and Light Shader Info node path used by this branch for direct surface lighting, forward and Shader to RGB paths, and volume direct scattering.
passCriteria: The test must create the Eevee light shader nodes in Light datablock node trees, verify default pass-through stays identical to the non-custom path, verify custom color/intensity/attenuation/range behavior in direct lighting, verify Scene Time and info vector outputs work, verify forward/blended materials read uniform light shader results, verify Shader to RGB reads the front-most point-dependent light shader cache, and verify volume direct scattering responds to custom color, attenuation, Light Space, and Scene Time.
